n: Swift Playgrounds and Everyone Can Code
t: Apple's free coding curriculum that teaches Swift through puzzles on iPad and Mac.
steps: Install Swift Playgrounds on an iPad or Mac.
Download the teacher guide from Apple Books.
Ask IT to deploy the app on school devices.
Work through the first Puzzles yourself.
Choose the guide that fits your grade level.
Plan the lesson time. Puzzles takes about 40 hours and Adventures about 45 hours, per a search snippet.
Look at the tactile graphics for students who need them.
